_sources.name: TouchDesigner OSC In / OSC Out CHOP / DAT

_limitations: Passthrough mode — TouchDesigner's OSC surface is whatever the OSC In CHOP / DAT / OSC In DAT operators in the project decide to receive. The bridge forwards `/td/...` (with `/td` stripped) to UDP 7000. Replies from TouchDesigner via OSC Out CHOP / DAT pointed at port 7001 re-emit as `/td/...` to clients.
